articles.text: KĒ XIĀNSHENG: Qǐngwèn, nín zài nǎli gōngzuò?
MR. COOK: May I ask, where do you work?
ZHĀNG XIǍOJIĚ: Wǒ shi xuésheng. Wǒ lái niàn shū.
MISS ZHĀNG: I'm a student. I came here to study.
KĒ XIĀNSHENG: Ou, wǒ yě shi xuésheng. Nǐ niàn shénme?
MR. COOK: Oh, I'm a student too. What are you studying?
ZHĀNG XIǍOJIĚ: Wǒ niàn lìshǐ. Nǐ ne?
MISS ZHĀNG: I'm studying history. And you?
KĒ XIĀNSHENG: Wǒ zài zhèli xué Zhōngwén. Nǐ huì shuō Yīngwén ma?
MR. COOK: I'm studying Chinese here. Can you speak English?
ZHĀNG XIǍOJIĚ: Wǒ huì shuō yìdiǎn. Nǐde Zhōngguo huà hěn hǎo.
MISS ZHĀNG: I can speak a little. Your Chinese is very good.
KĒ XIĀNSHENG: Nǎli, nǎli. Wǒ jiù huì shuō yìdiǎn.
MR. COOK: Not at all, not at all. I can speak only a little.
ZHĀNG XIǍOJIĚ: Nǐ shi zài nǎli xuéde?
MISS ZHĀNG: Where did you study it?
